items.headline: Man Utd beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties after 1-1 draw at Croke Park
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Leeds United on penalty kicks after a 1-1 draw in Dublin friendly, with Joshua Zirkzee scoring during regular play.

items.headline: Rashford in 26-man squad for AC Milan friendly after return from Barcelona loan
items.summary: Marcus Rashford named in Manchester United squad for pre-season friendly against AC Milan on Aug 15, marking first appearance since December 2024.

items.headline: Sesko misses entire pre-season with shin injury
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko remains sidelined with shin injury throughout pre-season, with United hopeful he'll be fit for Hull City opener on August 22.

items.headline: Tielemans praises Rashford's return as tactical asset for Carrick
items.summary: Youri Tielemans backs Marcus Rashford's reintegration into squad, calling his return an advantage ahead of Premier League season.

items.headline: Mount expected to return for AC Milan friendly after PSG injury
items.summary: Mason Mount missed Leeds friendly but will likely be available for AC Milan match, with foot injury from PSG not a concern.
